AllowSignatureMethod.description_en:
The signature algorithm used when AuthType is set to APP. If this parameter is not specified, HmacSHA256 is used by default. Valid values:
HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256
AllowSignatureMethod.description_zh:
当AuthType为APP认证时，需要传该值明确签名算法。可选值如下，不传默认是HmacSHA256：

HmacSHA256
HmacSHA1,HmacSHA256

AppCodeAuthType.description_en:
The authentication type that supports AppCode. Valid values:
DEFAULT: default value. Supported after the API is listed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace.
DISABLE: AppCode authentication is not supported.
HEADER: AppCode authentication is supported only in the header.
HEADER_QUERY: AppCode authentication is supported in the header or query parameters
AppCodeAuthType.description_zh:
支持AppCode的认证类型。可选值：

DEFAULT：默认值：上架云市场后支持
DISABLE： 不支持AppCode调用方式
HEADER  ：仅在Header中支持
HEADER_QUERY ：可以在Header或者Query中支持

AuthType.description_en:
The security authentication type of the API. Valid values:
APP: only authorized applications can call the API.
ANONYMOUS: anonymous calls are allowed. Note the following when you allow anonymous calls:
Anyone who can obtain the API service information can call the API. The gateway does not authenticate the caller and cannot configure user-level throttling. If you make the API public, configure API-level throttling
AuthType.description_zh:
API安全认证类型，目前可以取值：

APP：只允许已授权的APP调用
ANONYMOUS：允许匿名调用，设置为允许匿名调用需要注意：
     - 任何能够获取该API服务信息的人，都将能够调用该API。网关不会对调用者做身份认证，也无法设置按用户的流量控制，若开放该API请设置好按API的流量控制

DisableInternet.description_en:

ForceNonceCheck.description_en:
If ForceNonceCheck is set to true, the X-Ca-Nonce parameter is forcibly checked during requests. X-Ca-Nonce is a unique identifier for the request and is typically a UUID. API Gateway validates this parameter, and the same value can only be used once within 15 minutes. This effectively prevents replay attacks.
If ForceNonceCheck is set to false, the parameter is not checked. Default value: false
ForceNonceCheck.description_zh:
设置ForceNonceCheck为true, 请求时强制检查X-Ca-Nonce，这个是请求的唯一标识，一般使用UUID来标识。API网关收到这个参数后会校验这个参数的有效性，同样的值，15分内只能被使用一次。可以有效防止API的重放攻击。

设置ForceNonceCheck为false，则不检查。创建API时默认为false
